 Oral Order

3 09-11-2023 Heard Mr. Sheikh Arkan Ahmad, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and Mr.
Nitya Nand Tiwary, learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail in connection with Complaint Case No. 426 of 2022 registered for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The present case relates to matrimonial dispute between the petitioner and the opposite party no.2 who are husband and wife.
4. The matter was referred before the Mediator, Patna High Court Mediation Centre vide order dated 23.08.2023.

It has been informed by the Mediator of this Court that the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.54466 of 2023(3) dt.09-11-2023 mediation has ended in success and the parties have settled their dispute.
5.
In view of the aforesaid, the bail application stands disposed of.
